summary: Implemented the Empirical Claim Ledger to track the durable history of simulation-supported results. Bound the ledger to confidence propagation and runtime drift events and implemented governance guardrails for status changes.

charter_compliance_check.notes: The empirical claim ledger correctly enforces provenance mandates by requiring a durable historical record of all status changes, ensuring that empirical support is always traceable to specific results and runtime contexts.
